blockers.description: G-01 / CR-02 - execute_trade awaits wait_for_price before the transaction and never registers the symbol with the market source, so 'trading an unwatched ticker adds it to the watchlist' (PORT-07, ROADMAP SC2) can never fill. The passing test only passes because its fixture hand-injects PYPL into the price cache.
blockers.workaround: None. Requires a seam-contract decision - execute_trade(db_path, cache, ticker, side, quantity) holds no MarketDataSource by design.

blockers.description: G-02 / CR-01 - main.py:55 starts the source from the DEFAULT_TICKERS constant, not the persisted watchlist. A user-added ticker survives restart in the DB but gets no feed: null price, excluded from total_value, unsellable (400), unremovable (409).
blockers.workaround: None. Full portfolio reset is the only in-app recovery.

blockers.description: G-03 / CR-03 - when snapshot_loop dies of anything but CancelledError, the exception propagates out of the lifespan before source.stop() at main.py:63, so the market source and simulator-loop task outlive the app.
blockers.workaround: Cosmetic on the happy path; only bites after a snapshot-loop failure such as a transient 'database is locked'.
